text:
sam: Morning — I'm onboarding and hitting a wall with the dev k8s cluster. I run `kubectl get pods` and get `You must be logged in to the server (Unauthorized)`. KUBECONFIG points at ~/.kube/config. Has anyone run through the kubeconfig/RBAC steps recently?

infra-bot: Hi Sam, welcome! :wave: Start here: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/kubernetes (step-by-step). Short version: fetch SSO kubeconfig, set context, request RBAC if you need namespace access.

alex: welcome! we use Okta SSO + our redwood-cli to generate kubeconfigs. run: 
```
redwood-cli auth sso --provider okta
redwood-cli kubeconfig fetch --env dev
```
then `kubectl config get-contexts` and `kubectl config use-context redwood-dev`.

maria: if you don't want the CLI, I can add you to the `k8s-dev-readers` group manually. I just need your GitHub username and which namespaces you need access to.

sam: thanks — GH handle is @sammorr. I tried `kubectl config get-contexts` earlier and only saw `* minikube`. I think my local kubeconfig was never updated by the onboarding flow.

alex: that explains it. Also watch out for KUBECONFIG merging: if you have multiple kubeconfigs, `KUBECONFIG` env var controls the merge order. To inspect the active context after fetch run: 
```
kubectl config view --minify
kubectl config current-context
```
If `redwood-dev` still missing, try `export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config:~/.kube/redwood` then `kubectl config view --flatten > ~/.kube/merged` and `export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/merged`.

jamal: I can also expedite RBAC. Maria / Alex — can you grant sam view on `platform-dev` and `default` for onboarding? I'll set a 24h expiry.

maria: done — added `sammorr` to `k8s-dev-readers` and granted view to `platform-dev` + `default` for 24h.

sam: confirmed — `kubectl get pods -n platform-dev` now returns a list. Everything looks good. Thanks everyone! :tada: 

alex: awesome. One tip — if you need elevated access for debugging, follow the temporary elevation flow (link in onboarding doc) and include the ticket ID. Otherwise keep requests to minimal namespaces.

sam: noted. Appreciate the quick help.
